main.description: An extension staff attached to a thread. Lives in the forum account's repo and is written only by the forum itself, never by an extension. The record key is derived from the thread's at-uri, so a thread holds at most one binding.

thread.description: The app.atmobb.discussion.thread the extension is attached to. Its board is public.

extension.description: The extension's source repository, as its normalized git URL.

attachedBy.description: The staff member who attached the extension.
